levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: «قال رأيت أبا كاهل وكانت له صحبة» is Ismail's own sight of the Companion: a scene, not a link (rule 6)

«فحدثني أخي، عنه» : the brother is a bare relation, and «عنه» points back to Abu Kahil named in the scene; the Companion is not written as a link. The correspondence in another work carries Abu Kahil as the last link: recorded here, not applied
